div.head: Wif 6
div.ab: Gif hy þonne ælces þinges sammæle beon, ðonne fon magas to ⁊ weddian heora magan to wife ⁊ to rihtlife ðam ðe hire girnde; ⁊ fo to þam borge se ðe ðæs weddes waldend sy.
Gif hy ðonne ælces ðinges sammæle beon, ðonne fon magas to ⁊ wedian heora magan to wife ⁊ to rihtlife ðam ðe hire gyrnde; ⁊ fo to ðam borge se ðe ðæs weddes waldend sy.
Si tunc in omni re concordent, adeat cognatio et despondeat eam (uiro) to þiue ⁊ to rihtliue (id est in uxorem et rectam uitam); et excipiat inde plegium qui ius habet in uadio.

Wenn nun die [beiden Parteien] über jedes Ding einverstanden sind, mögen [die Braut-]Sippen [das Verlöbniss] annehmen, indem sie ihre Verwandte zum Eheweibe und gesetzmässigen [Zusammen]leben demjenigen verloben, der ihrer begehrt hat; und jene Bürgschaft empfange, wer Leiter des Verlobungsvertrages ist.

If the [two parties] then agree on everything, let the [bride's] kindred accept [the betrothal] by betrothing their kinswoman as wife and to lawful [married] life to him who has sought her; and let whoever is the controller of the betrothal agreement receive the surety.

If they then reach agreement about everything, then the kinsmen are to set about betrothing their kinswoman as wife and in lawful matrimony to him who has asked for her, and he who is leader of the betrothal is to receive the security.

note.label: see
note.quote: Namely, the one who gave surety for the completion of the marriage contract. See Wifmannes Beweddung §6.

div.note: B's ‘wedian’ stands so.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘If they then reach agreement about everything, then the kinsmen are to set about betrothing their kinswoman as wife and in lawful matrimony to him who has asked for her, and he who is the leader of the betrothal is to receive the security.’).

Der Gen. þinges hängt von dem Nord. Lehnwort sammæle ab; er ersetzt ymbe, das Toller zitiert
The gen. þinges depends on the Norse loanword sammæle; it replaces ymbe, which Toller cites

Die auxiliare Bed. von fon to passt vielleicht VI As 8, 4, zu Duns 1, 1 und laut Q auch hier. Price, Schmid, Sohm, Brunner denken wie meine Übersetzung an Akzeptieren der Verhandlung. Vielleicht sinnlicher (wie folg. Z.⁵) ‘die Braut ergreifen’; s. Gl Eheschliessung 8s

The auxiliary meaning of fon to perhaps fits VI As 8, 4 and Duns 1, 1, and, according to Q, here too. Price, Schmid, Sohm and Brunner, like my translation, think of acceptance of the negotiation. Perhaps more concretely (as in the following l.⁵) ‘take hold of the bride’; see Gl Eheschliessung 8s

Dass die reimenden Wörter ein Formelstück darstellen, bestätigt Q's Beibehaltung. Beide Wörter geben Einen Begriff ‘gesetzliche Ehe’, wie riht lif im Ggs. zu unrihthæmed (Wif 3) und rihtwif zu cifese (II Cn 54, 1) oder unrihtwif (Toller) steht

That the rhyming words form a piece of formula is confirmed by Q’s retaining them. Both words express a single concept, ‘lawful marriage’, just as riht lif stands in contrast to unrihthæmed (Wif 3), and rihtwif to cifese (II Cn 54, 1) or unrihtwif (Toller)

Nicht ‘die Bürgschaft für die Braut nehme auf sich, wer vom Bräutigam das Pfand empfängt’ (Price) = ‘subeat fideiussionem’ (Phillips); denn fon to ist das Gegenteil von ‘leisten, geben’, was dieser Sinn wäre

Not ‘let him who receives the pledge from the bridegroom undertake the surety for the bride’ (Price) = ‘subeat fideiussionem’ (Phillips); for fon to is the opposite of ‘render, give’, which this sense would require
Vielleicht der Verlobungsbürge in Ine 31; vgl. Gl Eheschliessung 8r; Bürgschaft 7a. [Man ergänze dort, als 7aa, diesen Satz und streiche in 7b die Wörter: 12 . . dem Verlobungsleiter . . 5f.]
Perhaps the betrothal surety in Ine 31; cf. Gl Eheschliessung 8r; Bürgschaft 7a. [There add this sentence as 7aa, and in 7b delete the words: 12 . . dem Verlobungsleiter . . 5f.]
